---
title: "Items Explorer"
---

Word recognition varies enormously across items. Each thin line is one
target word's looking curve; the dark line is a weighted smooth across
items. Switch tabs to follow a single word across every dataset that
tested it.

:::: {.viz-layout}

::: {.viz-sidebar}

```{ojs items-inputs}
viewof all_datasets = Inputs.toggle({ label: "All datasets", value: false })
viewof sel_datasets = Inputs.select(datasetNames, {
  label: "Datasets", multiple: 5, value: ["pomper_saffran_2016"],
  format: (d) => datasetLabel(d), disabled: all_datasets,
})
viewof age_range = interval([0, 84], {
  step: 1, value: [0, 84], label: "Ages (months)",
})
viewof word_category = Inputs.select(
  ["all"].concat(availableCategories),
  { label: "Word category", value: "all" })
viewof lexical_class = Inputs.select(
  ["all"].concat(availableClasses),
  { label: "Lexical class", value: "all" })
viewof highlight_words = Inputs.select(allWords, {
  label: "Highlight words", multiple: 5, value: [],
})
viewof plot_window = interval([-1000, 4000], {
  step: 25, value: [-500, 3000], label: "Time window (msec)",
})
viewof min_n = Inputs.range([1, 50], {
  step: 1, value: 10, label: "Min looks per point",
})
viewof include_excluded = Inputs.toggle({ label: "Excluded trials", value: true })
```

For the cross-dataset view:

```{ojs items-word-input}
wordIndex = d3.json("slices/words.json")

viewof focus_word = Inputs.select(
  Object.keys(wordIndex).sort((a, b) =>
    wordIndex[b].length - wordIndex[a].length || a.localeCompare(b)),
  { label: "Word (across datasets)", value: "dog",
    format: (w) => `${w} (${wordIndex[w].length})` })
```

:::

::: {.viz-main}

```{ojs items-data}
//| output: false
active_datasets = all_datasets ? datasetNames : sel_datasets
slices = Promise.all(active_datasets.map(loadSlice))
allWords = wordsOf(slices)

wordCategories = d3.json("slices/word_categories.json")

availableCategories = [...new Set(allWords
  .map((w) => wordCategories[w]?.[0]).filter(Boolean))].sort()
availableClasses = [...new Set(allWords
  .map((w) => wordCategories[w]?.[1]).filter(Boolean))].sort()

categoryWords = {
  if (word_category === "all" && lexical_class === "all") return null;
  return new Set(allWords.filter((w) => {
    const c = wordCategories[w];
    if (!c) return false;
    return (word_category === "all" || c[0] === word_category) &&
           (lexical_class === "all" || c[1] === lexical_class);
  }));
}

wordCurves = {
  const [tLo, tHi] = plot_window;
  const rows = buildRows(slices, {
    ageLo: age_range[0], ageHi: age_range[1],
    includeExcluded: include_excluded,
  });
  const acc = new Map();
  for (const r of rows) {
    let t = r.t0;
    for (const [aoi, len] of r.runs) {
      for (let k = 0; k < len; k++, t += STEP_MS) {
        if (t <= tLo || t >= tHi || aoi > 1) continue;
        const key = `${r.dataset}|${r.word}|${t}`;
        let e = acc.get(key);
        if (!e) acc.set(key, e = { dataset: r.dataset, word: r.word, t, n: 0, p: 0 });
        e.n += 1;
        if (aoi === 0) e.p += 1;
      }
    }
  }
  return Array.from(acc.values(), (e) => ({
    dataset: e.dataset, word: e.word, t: e.t, n: e.n, prop: e.p / e.n,
  })).filter((d) => d.n >= min_n &&
             (categoryWords == null || categoryWords.has(d.word)))
    .sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t);
}

datasetSmooths = {
  const out = [];
  for (const [dataset, g] of d3.group(wordCurves, (d) => d.dataset)) {
    const sm = loess_points(g, { x: "t", y: "prop", w: "n", span: 0.3, grid: 80 });
    for (const p of sm) out.push({ dataset, t: p.t, prop: p.prop });
  }
  return out;
}

nItems = d3.group(wordCurves, (d) => d.dataset, (d) => d.word)
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Item variability

```{ojs items-count}
html`<p style="color:#6b7280; margin:0 0 0.5rem 0">${
  Array.from(nItems, ([ds, words]) => `${ds}: ${words.size} items`).join(" · ")
}</p>`
```

```{ojs items-plot}
{
  document.querySelectorAll(".pb-spinner").forEach((el) => el.remove());
  const highlighted = new Set(highlight_words);
  const facets = new Set(wordCurves.map((d) => d.dataset));
  const base = wordCurves.filter((d) => !highlighted.has(d.word));
  const hi = wordCurves.filter((d) => highlighted.has(d.word));
  return Plot.plot({
    width, height: Math.max(420, 300 * Math.ceil(facets.size / 2)),
    grid: true,
    x: { label: "Time (msec)" },
    y: { label: "Proportion target looking", domain: [0, 1] },
    color: { legend: highlighted.size > 0, label: "Word" },
    fy: facets.size > 1 ? { label: null } : undefined,
    marks: [
      Plot.lineY(base, {
        x: "t", y: "prop", z: "word", stroke: "#9ca3af",
        strokeOpacity: 0.45, strokeWidth: 0.8,
        ...(facets.size > 1 ? { fy: "dataset" } : {}),
      }),
      Plot.lineY(hi, {
        x: "t", y: "prop", z: "word", stroke: "word", strokeWidth: 2,
        ...(facets.size > 1 ? { fy: "dataset" } : {}),
      }),
      Plot.lineY(datasetSmooths, {
        x: "t", y: "prop", stroke: "#111827", strokeWidth: 2.5,
        ...(facets.size > 1 ? { fy: "dataset" } : {}),
      }),
      Plot.ruleY([0.5], { strokeDasharray: "4 4" }),
      Plot.ruleX([0], { strokeDasharray: "4 4" }),
      Plot.tip(wordCurves, Plot.pointer({
        x: "t", y: "prop",
        title: (d) => `${d.word}\n${d.prop.toFixed(2)} at ${d.t} ms (n=${d.n})`,
        ...(facets.size > 1 ? { fy: "dataset" } : {}),
      })),
    ],
  });
}
```

Hover to identify items; pick words in the sidebar to highlight them.

### Word across datasets

```{ojs word-across}
focusCurves = {
  const [tLo, tHi] = plot_window;
  const dss = wordIndex[focus_word] ?? [];
  const loaded = await Promise.all(dss.map(loadSlice));
  const rows = buildRows(loaded, {
    ageLo: age_range[0], ageHi: age_range[1],
    words: [focus_word], includeExcluded: include_excluded,
  });
  const acc = new Map();
  for (const r of rows) {
    let t = r.t0;
    for (const [aoi, len] of r.runs) {
      for (let k = 0; k < len; k++, t += STEP_MS) {
        if (t <= tLo || t >= tHi || aoi > 1) continue;
        const key = `${r.dataset}|${t}`;
        let e = acc.get(key);
        if (!e) acc.set(key, e = { dataset: r.dataset, t, n: 0, p: 0 });
        e.n += 1;
        if (aoi === 0) e.p += 1;
      }
    }
  }
  return Array.from(acc.values(), (e) => ({
    dataset: e.dataset, t: e.t, n: e.n, prop: e.p / e.n,
  })).filter((d) => d.n >= min_n).sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t);
}
```

```{ojs word-across-plot}
{
  const nDs = new Set(focusCurves.map((d) => d.dataset)).size;
  return Plot.plot({
    width, height: 500, grid: true,
    x: { label: "Time (msec)" },
    y: { label: `Proportion target looking: "${focus_word}"`, domain: [0, 1] },
    color: { legend: true, label: "Dataset" },
    marks: [
      Plot.lineY(focusCurves, {
        x: "t", y: "prop", stroke: "dataset", strokeWidth: 1.5,
        tip: true, title: (d) => `${d.dataset}\n${d.prop.toFixed(2)} (n=${d.n})`,
      }),
      Plot.ruleY([0.5], { strokeDasharray: "4 4" }),
      Plot.ruleX([0], { strokeDasharray: "4 4" }),
    ],
  });
}
```

Every dataset in the current release that tested this word, filtered by the
sidebar's age range. Curves use each dataset's own design (carrier phrases,
distractors, timing), so differences reflect both development and design.
